chapter_summary: Blue pigment gathers in the lamp's narrow circle, making the night seem briefly immense. Debolina sees how limited means can sharpen attention.

spatality.place: a ledge inside a haveli, one lamp and a shallow dish of ground lapis
spatality.route: lamp to dish to wall, a circle no wider than the arm
spatality.texture: fine blue dust, lamp heat on the cheek, a blue darker than the room

poetic_parameters.movement: Sufism — ecstatic union sought through a single material, the lamp's small circle as the whole world.
writing_skills: incantatory repetition of one colour word
a devotional address to a stone
close on a blessing that is also a limit
poetic_parameters.image_seed: a shallow dish of lapis lit from one side by a lamp with a cracked chimney
poetic_parameters.volta: from the blue as wealth to the blue as a wage paid nightly
poetic_parameters.sonic_texture: the long u of blue held and repeated, broken by the flat a of lamp
poetic_parameters.line_gesture: flowing lines that lengthen as the circle of light widens, then shorten as it fails
poetic_parameters.variety_note: Chapter four measured time by plaster setting; this poem measures it by a lamp that will burn out before the work does.
poetic_parameters.metaphor_family: small light, precious dust, and the economy of a colour that costs more than the wall
poetic_parameters.address: the pigment, then the lamp, then the self as the smallest of the three
poetic_parameters.closing_move: a benediction that turns out to be a warning about dawn
